نغرورق (form XII)
# نَغْرَوْرِقُ (naḡrawriqu) /naɣ.raw.ri.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِغْرَوْرَقَ (iḡrawraqa)
# نَغْرَوْرِقَ (naḡrawriqa) /naɣ.raw.ri.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِغْرَوْرَقَ (iḡrawraqa)
# نَغْرَوْرِقْ (naḡrawriq) /naɣ.raw.riq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِغْرَوْرَقَ (iḡrawraqa)
